svg.aria-label: Reconciliation results from one session on 2026-11-17: 8 of 8 checks passed after the demo (20,000 transactions with 12,600 replayed records and 6 poison records); 8 of 8 passed after the chaos test (a SIGKILL, an offset replay and two failpoint crashes); all 53,512 Kafka records are accounted for, 53,506 in bronze and 6 dead letters, with no offset twice; and with silver corrupted on purpose 7 of 8 checks passed, with the changed and the deleted payment named.
